transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having sinus congestion and drainage for the last several days. That's what's been bothering me most.
Could you tell me how much the congestion and drainage are affecting you day to day, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
The congestion is bothersome, but overall I feel well — I still walk 1 to 2 miles most days, at the local mall when the weather's bad. I haven't noticed any allergies or bad reactions to medicines.

Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken recently—including anything new or changed, and the dose if you know it—and also about any health problems you’ve had, operations, or times you’ve stayed in hospital?

I was diagnosed with diabetes last fall. I check my blood sugar about once a day, and my readings run between 82 and 132. I can't remember the names or doses of any medicines I'm on, and I haven't had any operations or hospital stays that I recall.
Have you noticed anything else going on along with the congestion and drainage, and is there anything that seems to make it better or worse?

I haven't had any abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or constipation, and no blood in my urine or stools. I do get up once a night to pass urine, but there's no swelling in my ankles, and I haven't noticed anything that clearly makes the congestion better or worse.

Can you tell me how the congestion and drainage have been coming and going for you—whether they’re steady or off and on, how often they show up, how long they tend to last, and if there’s a time of day when you notice them more?
They've just been present for the last several days — I haven't really noticed them coming and going in any particular pattern, and I can't say there's a time of day when they're worse.

Other than your diabetes, are there any health conditions you see a doctor or nurse about regularly, or any operations or hospital stays in the past that you haven’t mentioned—or is there nothing else?
Beyond the diabetes, my mammogram is up to date and I see a gynaecologist regularly, and I check my feet regularly. I haven't had any operations or hospital stays that I haven't already mentioned.

Since the congestion and drainage started, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy, or any changes in your bladder or bowel habits or breathing—or have those stayed about the same?

I haven't noticed any changes in my appetite, sleep, weight or energy, and my breathing seems fine. My bladder and bowel habits are about the same — I get up once a night to pass urine, and nothing else has changed.
How much are the congestion and drainage affecting your daily life right now—on a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is not at all and 10 is very much?
I'd put it at about a 2 or 3 — it's bothersome but I still feel well overall and keep up my walking.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
